response.rationale: R2 directly matches the Gram-positive cocci bacteremia with multiple organ involvement (necrotizing pneumonia, renal abscesses), while R6 only captures the cutaneous purpuric lesions and vascular organisms without the visceral septic foci, making R2 the more complete and specific diagnosis.

rejected.why: Only describes a single imaging finding (septic emboli) without integrating the overall septic syndrome.
Append-only completion of R8, still limited to the brain emboli and not the systemic infection.
Only addresses the pulmonary necrotizing pneumonia, ignoring the renal, skin, and vascular findings.
Lacks direct evidence of DIC (no coagulopathy labs) and does not account for the Gram-positive cocci or visceral abscesses.
Overlaps with R2 but has only a single support span (Gram stain) and lacks the multi-organ septic evidence.
